## Problem

What use case is not supported? Use synthetic examples without sensitive data.

## Proposed Change

Describe the desired behavior and who would benefit.

## Alternatives

What existing features or workarounds did you consider?

## Security and Operational Impact

Consider tenant isolation, privacy, fail-closed behavior, dependencies and
deployment requirements. If this reveals a vulnerability, use SECURITY.md instead.

## Acceptance Criteria

How could maintainers verify that the change meets the need?
